source_citation.text: A copy of the signed minute order initiating ICPC. [...] Obtain the signed minute order [before submitting the ICPC packet].
source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10, 'Out-of-State Placement in a Family Home' > 'Case-Carrying CSW Responsibilities'. NOTE ON SOURCE TYPE: this is a COUNTY-level policy manual (Los Angeles County), not a statewide CDSS regulation or written directive -- California administers child welfare at the county level, so implementation specifics can vary by county even though all counties operate under the same state/federal ICPC framework. Treat this as representative, illustrative county practice, not binding statewide text. If your demo names a specific California county, prefer that county's own policy manual if reachable; otherwise this is a reasonable, real, cited stand-in.

source_citation.text: Case plan. Most recent court report. A copy of the child's Social Security card. Birth certificate. Supporting medical, dental, developmental, educational, and mental health documents.
source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10, same section as above. Same county-vs-state caveat applies.

source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10. Same county-vs-state caveat applies.

source_citation.text: ICPC Financial/Medical Plan. [...corroborated statewide:] generate the Financial/Medical Plan document.
source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10 (document requirement), corroborated by CDSS All County Information Notice I-95-06, Attachment A / Data Entry Instructions, p.9 (https://www.cdss.ca.gov/getinfo/acin06/pdf/I-95_06.pdf) -- this is the one sending-side item confirmed at BOTH the county-policy and statewide-CDSS level, so it carries more confidence than the county-only items above.

source_citation.text: DCFS 710, Interstate Compact on Placement of Children (ICPC) Fact Sheet, and supporting medical psychological and academic documents.
source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10. This specific form number (DCFS 710) is an LA County form -- another county would use its own form number for the same underlying fact-sheet content. County-vs-state caveat applies.

source_citation.text: Complete the ICPC 100A page and generate the 100A form to send to the receiving state. Be sure to complete all mandatory fields. [County-level: use] DCFS 711 if a regular ICPC request or the DCFS 712 if an expedited ICPC request.
source_citation.page_or_section: CDSS All County Information Notice I-95-06, 'Outgoing Requests' section, p.2 (statewide CWS/CMS data-entry instruction) -- the DCFS 711/712 form numbers are LA County's own cover-sheet forms layered on top of the statewide ICPC-100A, corroborated by https://policy.dcfs.lacounty.gov/Policy?id=5843.

source_citation.text: For expedited requests, submit the required paperwork within three (3) business days [of receiving the court order].
source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10, 'Case-Carrying CSW Responsibilities'. COUNTY-LEVEL TIMELINE, not confirmed as a statewide CDSS requirement in this pass -- flag before treating as CA-wide.

source_citation.text: [The county Out-of-County Services unit must,] within five (5) business days of the receipt of all necessary ICPC packet information, forward the complete packet to the receiving state.
source_citation.page_or_section: LA County DCFS Policy 0100-525.10, 'Out-of-County Services (OCS) Outgoing Unit Responsibilities'. COUNTY-LEVEL TIMELINE, same caveat as above.

source_citation.text: Remain responsible for all aspects of the child's case planning and implementation. Maintain monthly telephone contact with the caregiver and child.
